definition: LiteLLM is an open-source large language model (LLM) gateway developed by BerriAI.
details: It provides a unified OpenAI-compatible application programming interface (API) for accessing and routing requests to different model providers. LiteLLM can be deployed as a self-hosted proxy server or used as a Python library within applications.

explainer.lead: How to install LiteLLM, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.

install.javascript: npm install openai   # call the LiteLLM proxy

quickstart.python:
from litellm import completion

for model in ["gpt-4o-mini", "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5", "ollama/llama3.2"]:
    resp = completion(model=model, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Say hello"}])
    print(model, resp.choices[0].message.content)

explainer.inAi: One OpenAI-style call for 100+ providers, plus a proxy with budgets, fallbacks and logging for teams.
